audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile's head resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the texture of the skin, the eye, and the interlocking teeth of the slightly open jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, forming a clear V-shape characteristic of Crocodylus niloticus, distinct from the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible. The fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears prominent, fitting the interlocking description. The jaw structure looks robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull. A vertical pupil is visible, and the surrounding anatomy suggests the presence of protective membranes typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although partially obscured by the angle and shadow, the nasal opening is located at the distal end of the snout as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck region are visible; the full body length cannot be verified in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the head and neck shows distinct, raised, bony plates (scutes) with a rough, armored appearance consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green, brown, and grey with significant textural detail showing roughness and wear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (belly) of the crocodile is not visible in this profile/top-down view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely outside the field of view.
